verdict.rationale: Antigravity has extension points that can carry third-party capabilities into agent workflows: namespaced plugins that bundle skills, rules, MCP servers and hooks; downloadable skills; and MCP connections to external tools and APIs. The SDK also lets you layer MCP servers and skills into custom agents. However, nothing shows a partner ecosystem or marketplace of third-party-built agent apps that plug in as agents. missing for 10: partner agent-app marketplace or directory, documented integration of external third-party agents (as opposed to tools/skills), independent corroboration of partner integrations.
